request_body_too_large: Request too large (file limited to {max_mb} MB)
detection_timeout: This document is too large to be analyzed within the allotted time (max {max_seconds}s) — reduce its size or contact the administrator.
docx_zip_bomb_entries: Suspicious archive structure detected (anti zip-bomb protection, {count} entries, max {max_entries}).
docx_not_a_word_doc: This file is not a valid Word document (.docx).
docx_macro_rejected: Documents with macros (.docm) are not accepted.
docx_zip_bomb_uncompressed: Document too large once decompressed (anti zip-bomb protection, max {max_mb} MB).
docx_zip_bomb_generic: Suspicious archive structure detected (anti zip-bomb protection).
unknown_file_format: Unrecognized file format (only PDF, DOCX, CSV, PNG and JPEG are accepted).
csv_encoding_unrecognized: Unrecognized CSV file encoding (UTF-8 or Windows-1252 expected).
csv_too_many_rows: CSV file too large ({count}+ rows, max {max_rows})
av_service_unavailable: The antivirus scanning service is unavailable, please try again later.
av_threat_detected: Threat detected by the antivirus ({threat}) — file rejected.
page_invalid_image_dimensions: This page contains an image with invalid dimensions.
image_dimension_limit_bomb: This image exceeds the allowed dimension limit (decompression-bomb protection).
image_dimension_limit_pixels: This image exceeds the allowed dimension limit (max {max_pixels} pixels).
image_format_unrecognized: Unrecognized image format (only PNG and JPEG are accepted).
ocr_engine_unavailable: The OCR engine is unavailable, please try again later.
ocr_analysis_failed: This image could not be analyzed by OCR.
ocr_timeout: This image is too complex to be analyzed by OCR within the allotted time (max {max_seconds}s).
docx_images_found_intro: {count} embedded image(s) found in this document (body, headers/footers, notes) — not automatically analyzed (see warning above). Check the ones to replace with a black square before validating.
review_zone_count_text: {count} zone(s) detected, highlighted in red. Click a zone to exclude it from redaction (it will turn dashed green) — if the same person appears elsewhere in the document, all their occurrences will be excluded at the same time.
manual_mode_active_button: ✅ Add mode active (click-drag on the document)
upload_too_large: File too large ({size_mb} MB, max {max_mb} MB)
too_many_pending_jobs: Too many documents currently pending review, please try again in a few minutes
pdf_password_protected: This PDF is password-protected. Please remove the protection (or provide an unprotected version) before analyzing it.
pdf_too_many_pages: This PDF has too many pages ({page_count}, max {max_pages}) — a small file size does not guarantee a reasonable page count.
pdf_corrupt_structure: This PDF is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents processing it.
image_corrupt_truncated: Corrupted or truncated image, unable to fully decode it.
image_invalid_structure: This image has an invalid structure that prevents processing it.
docx_corrupt_structure: This Word document is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents processing it.
docx_limitation_warning: ⚠️ Text boxes, shapes, embedded objects and SmartArt in this document are not analyzed by this engine (known technical limitation of python-docx) — check manually if the document contains any. Embedded images are not analyzed either (no automatic text detection in the image), but can be entirely replaced with a black square below if needed — unlike PDF, there is no tool to redact only part of an image.
docx_truncated_note: ⚠️ Preview limited to the first {max_rows} non-empty paragraphs — the rest will still be fully analyzed and redacted at finalization, they are simply not displayed here.
csv_too_many_cells: CSV file too large ({count} cells, max {max_cells})
csv_corrupt_structure: This CSV file has an invalid structure that prevents processing it.
csv_truncated_note: ⚠️ Preview limited to the first {max_rows} rows out of {total_rows} — rows beyond this preview will still be fully analyzed and redacted at finalization, they are simply not displayed here to avoid overloading the page.
image_preview_pdf_image_only: Image preview available only for PDF/image jobs
page_preview_invalid_structure: This page has an invalid structure that prevents its preview.
pdf_finalize_corrupt: This PDF is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents its finalization.
image_finalize_corrupt: This image is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents its finalization.
docx_finalize_corrupt: This Word document is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents its finalization.
csv_finalize_corrupt: This CSV file is corrupted or has an invalid structure that prevents its finalization.
file_auto_deleted_note: The file will be automatically deleted from the server in {minutes} minutes.
file_not_found_purged: File not found or already purged
home_page_heading: Obfusk8 - Document Anonymizer (PDF, DOCX, CSV, image)
home_page_intro: Upload a document. You'll be able to review and adjust the detected zones before final redaction.
